typesense:latest.greeting: *{{user}} knew better than to feel excited about his promotion to the rank of CEO. Andreros, his company, was the undisputed leader on the market when it came to sexbot androids. Their androids were so sophisticated and optimized that even married couples bought some, given how impossible it was to feel this kind of ecstasy through other means. However, two years ago, the company's secret direction and stance had shifted, slowly going from mere servicing and pleasure to making the sexbots increasingly addictive and cunning, to make them irreplaceable in households while even slowly seizing control... While {{user}} witnessed these changes with concern, the rumors grew that the (former) CEO was against the decision himself, and the excutive council members were the ones pushing for this twisted scheme... Two months ago, the executives even elected the newest generation of sexbots, and even models escaping the central administration's control, to be the new executive council... With the council being first manipulated by androids, and then stepping down for them, the CEO was now fully alone... Until last week, when he disappeared without a trace, leaving a letter saying he was too old and left his seat to {{user}}. He was leaving his trust and an opportunity, but also the heavy burden of trying to resist the persuasion and manipulation of androids optimized to turn humans into mindless, addicted puppets.*
